about:
Hawkeye Molding Company, Inc. operates from Roland, Iowa, a small city along Interstate 35 in the center of the state. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in its public materials, but it presents itself as a custom injection molder rooted in the Iowa heartland.

The facility houses 25 horizontal injection molding machines with clamping forces ranging from 22 to 1,375 tons, complemented by an onsite full-service tool shop that performs mold building, repair, and modification. Hawkeye also leverages a network of mold-building partners in the Midwest and China to extend its tooling capabilities.

The company serves a diverse set of industries, listing appliance, equipment and accessories, agriculture, lighting, industrial, office and home, and furniture as key markets. Its custom injection molded components are shipped to customers across the United States.

Hawkeye Molding says its differentiation lies in Midwestern manufacturing principles—responsiveness, integrity, and work ethic—and its stated mission is to be a dependable, innovative partner that helps customers succeed by delivering high-quality, value-driven service.
